sources.researchNote: The academy’s catalogue transcribes the score title as crediting Jan Kiepura with singing the song in Tout pour l’amour. Its publication details give copyright 1933; this is the date of the described score, not the date of the online catalogue record or evidence for a particular sound recording. Rechecked on 3 November 2026: the academy’s catalogue server did not answer, though its domain still resolves and the academy’s own site is up. The record is kept because its transcription holds — the plate number E.A.S. 8814 it gives is independently attested in the antiquarian trade — and because the Bibliothèque nationale notice for the same Salabert edition names no singer, leaving this the only witness to the Kiepura billing.
